name: Molecular, Cellular and Developmental Biology (MCDB) PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Final domestic and international deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated deadline; fall entry only. Central FAQ closes applications at 10 p.m. MST.

english.note: Pearson 75; Cambridge 190. Exemption for qualifying citizenship or at least one year full-time university study in U.S./qualifying country ending within two years of intended admission.

applicationFee.note: International fee $80. MCDB offers waivers/reimbursement for specified underrepresented groups, disabilities and disadvantaged backgrounds without express citizenship restriction; internationals confirm eligibility. Central listed-program waivers restricted to U.S. citizens/PR.

documents: Unofficial transcript from every undergraduate/graduate institution
requirements.note: Bachelor's from accredited college and cumulative GPA ≥2.75. Research experience preferred, not required. Genetics, cell/developmental biology, chemistry, biochemistry, calculus/statistics and physics preferred; missing areas do not exclude strong applicants.
